question: In how many cities will Rajasthan host the Fifth Khelo India University Games (KIUG) 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**7**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• The Fifth Khelo India University Games (KIUG) will be held in **7 cities of Rajasthan**, namely **Jaipur, Ajmer, Udaipur, Jodhpur, Bikaner, Kota, and Bharatpur**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The event will take place from **November 24** for 12 days, featuring **23 medal sports** and one demonstration sport—**Kho-Kho**.
 
• More than **5,000 university athletes** from across the country will participate in the games.
 
• Beach volleyball, canoeing, kayaking, and cycling are being introduced for the first time in the KIUG programme.
 
• The event aims to highlight India's expanding sporting landscape and inspire students to pursue sports alongside academics.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Khelo India Initiative**__: A national program aiming to promote sports at the grassroots level, identify and nurture young talent, and provide platforms for them to compete.
 
• __**Khelo India University Games**__: A key component of the Khelo India initiative, aimed at providing a competitive platform for university-level athletes across India.
 
• __**Rajasthan's Role**__: Hosting the fifth edition of the games in 7 cities will further cement Rajasthan's growing reputation as a hub for sports infrastructure and events.
 
• __**Prime Minister’s Vision**__: Under the leadership of Prime Minister Narendra Modi, Khelo India has focused on creating a robust ecosystem for sports participation and excellence in India.
